what_works: Photography-driven hero treatments emphasize texture and industrial materiality — every section reads like a project case study rather than a sales page. The eye lands on the work first, not a stock-art headline.
what_does_not_translate: The scroll-driven cinematic transitions are too heavy for a 4-second SMS open; keep the photo treatment, drop the choreography.
type_observations: Bold sans-serif display set tight against soft body copy — typographic weight does the trade-trust work, no script flourishes.
